loadFailure.title: We couldn’t load your gym setup.
loadFailure.body: Check your connection and try again.

gone.title: This gym draft is no longer available.
gone.body: It was discarded or you no longer manage it. You can start a new gym.

rail.title: Gym setup
rail.label: Gym setup steps

hints.locked: available after you create the gym

rail.laterCount: {count, plural, one {# more step comes later} other {# more steps come later}}

unconfirmed.create: We couldn’t confirm your gym was created.
unconfirmed.createBody: Nothing you typed is lost. Retry is safe: it never creates a second gym.
unconfirmed.save: We couldn’t confirm your changes were saved.
unconfirmed.saveBody: Nothing you typed is lost. Retry is safe: if the save went through, you’ll see the latest version.
unconfirmed.finish: We couldn’t confirm your gym was created.
unconfirmed.finishBody: Check your connection, then try again. Trying again is safe.

invalid.title: Check the highlighted fields.
invalid.body: Fix them to save this step.

account.title: Finish your account basics first.
account.body: Your name, date of birth and agreements come before your gym.

stale.title: This gym changed on another device or tab.
stale.body: We loaded the latest saved version and kept what you typed. Check it, then save your changes again.

resumed.title: You already have a gym in progress.
resumed.body: We opened it with its saved details and kept what you typed. Continue to save your changes to it.

discarded.title: That gym draft was discarded.
discarded.body: What you typed is still here. Continue to create a new gym with it.

reused.title: That gym draft is no longer yours to set up.
reused.body: What you typed is still here. Continue to create a new gym with it.

rateLimited.title: You’ve started several gyms today.
rateLimited.body: Try again later. What you typed is kept.
rateLimited.bodyAfter: Try again {time}. What you typed is kept.

forbidden.title: Only the gym’s owner can change its setup.
forbidden.body: Ask the owner to make this change.

gone.title: This gym draft is no longer available.
gone.body: It was discarded or you no longer manage it.

session.title: Your session ended.
session.body: Sign in again to continue. Your saved steps are kept.

conflict.title: We couldn’t save this right now.
conflict.body: Something else changed this gym at the same time. Try again.

errors.invalidFormat: This doesn’t look right. Check the format.

preview.label: Preview
preview.private: Members can’t see your gym yet. It stays private while you set it up.

type.title: Gym name & type
type.lead: Tell fighters who you are. You can change everything later.

another.title: You already have a gym in SimpleFit.
another.body: Continuing creates another, separate gym. Your existing gym stays as it is.

phone.label: Phone · optional
phone.help: Digits, spaces, brackets and dashes; may start with +.

website.label: Website · optional
website.help: We add https:// if you leave it out.

type.account: This gym belongs to the account you’re signed in with · one account for every role.

location.title: Location
location.lead: Where members find you. Your gym has one location for now.

entrance.label: Entrance note · optional
entrance.help: Helps people find the door. Up to 200 characters.

location.more: Adding more locations isn’t available yet.
location.note: Address only · SimpleFit never uses members’ location

preview.label: Address preview
preview.note: No maps and no location tracking: people see the address and your entrance note.

branding.title: Branding
branding.lead: Optional. Pick your colour and a tagline, or skip and add them later.

logo.label: Logo
logo.unavailable: Logo upload isn’t available yet. Your initials are used.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.help: Each colour is contrast-checked for light and dark themes.

cover.label: Cover photo
cover.unavailable: Cover photo upload isn’t available yet.

done.title: {name} is created.
done.lead: Your gym is set up in SimpleFit. It stays private: nothing is published and members can’t find it yet.
done.pendingTitle: Gym tools are on their way
done.pendingBody: Members, classes, payments and publishing aren’t available yet. They’ll arrive in later updates.
done.failureBody: Your gym is created. Check your connection and try again.
done.laterTitle: Get ready to open · coming later
